mission_06: Well done! You have implemented Local Outlier Factor, a sophisticated density-based method that excels at detecting anomalies in datasets with varying density regions. By comparing each point local density to that of its neighbors, LOF identifies outliers that global methods might miss. A point in a sparse region that is normal relative to its sparse neighbors would not be flagged, while a point that is sparse relative to its immediate neighbors would be detected regardless of the global density. This local perspective makes LOF ideal for complex datasets where anomalies can occur in both dense and sparse regions. The LOF score provides a continuous measure of outlierness, allowing for flexible thresholding and ranking of anomalies by severity.
